dish: All-you-can-eat Friday haddock fish fry with potato pancakes/fritters, or jäger schnitzel with spaetzle
address: County Hwy Y, Roxbury (3 mi SE of Sauk City), WI
w: A Roxbury tavern-and-dance-hall turned German supper club, run by the Maier family since 1959. Gold for Fish Fry in Madison Magazine's Best of Madison 2025 and winner of its 'Most Fabulous Fish Fry' contest; Milwaukee Record calls it the Friday-night pilgrimage.

address: 6712 Frank Lloyd Wright Ave, Middleton, WI 53562
w: Middleton taphouse (18 taps, 50 bottles) whose Hook's-cheddar curds took silver for Cheese Curds in Best of Madison 2025 and topped UpNorthNews readers' 2025 cheese-curd vote.
Madison's own super-premium ice cream since 1962; the 1964 State Street parlor is its oldest. Gold for Ice Cream in Best of Madison 2025 and UpNorthNews readers' best ice cream shop 2025.

dish: Beer-battered curds with Tipsy sauce; Wisconsin butter burger
address: King St at Main St, Capitol Square, Madison, WI 53703
w: Burger-and-whisky bar at the point of King and Main off the Square; bronze for Cheese Curds and Burger and a Best Bar medal in Best of Madison 2025; on UpNorthNews' best-curds list.

dish: All-you-can-eat haddock fish fry; smoked pulled pork
w: West-side seafood-and-smokehouse with branches in DeForest and Verona; silver for Fish Fry (and a Barbecue medal) in Best of Madison 2025, on Madison Magazine's fish-fry roundup, reviewed by the Cap Times.

dish: A brandy old fashioned (sweet, sour or press) — 108,504 poured in 2023 — then prime rib over Mirror Lake
address: Mirror Lake (inside Mirror Lake State Park), Lake Delton, WI
w: Summer-season supper club built in 1953 over Mirror Lake, with Norway pines growing through the floor; won in Best of Madison 2025 and profiled by Cook's Country as the archetype of the Wisconsin supper club.

dish: Friday fish fry (UpNorthNews readers' #1, 2025); prime rib
w: Madison's oldest restaurant — a 1947 north-side tavern turned supper club, run by the Kavanaugh family for nearly 80 years and voted the city's best fish fry in 2025. CLOSED: it shut in January 2026 a week after owner John Kavanaugh III died (WMTV, WKOW). Kept, flagged, as a piece of the supper-club canon.

dish: Moules-frites, steak frites with shallot butter, and the gruyère-draped bar hot dog
w: French bistro in a converted warehouse on the Lake Monona shore; on The Infatuation's 14 best in Madison, Imbibe's where-to-drink list (best bar seat for a Martini and oysters) and runner-up best restaurant + best view in UpNorthNews readers' 2025 vote.

dish: Supper-club classics reworked — relish tray, beef Wellington-style showpieces and a brandy old fashioned
address: West Washington Ave (by the former Milwaukee Road depot), Madison, WI
w: A 2021 high-end throwback to the Wisconsin supper club: Esquire's 40 best new restaurants in America, one of the New York Times' 50 favorite restaurants of 2022, featured on Top Chef Wisconsin, and The Infatuation's pick for Madison's best fine dining.

dish: The Plazaburger with the secret sauce (since 1963–64)
w: A Prohibition-era (1930) downtown tavern that invented the double-stack Plazaburger and still won't reveal its sauce; on City Cast's oldest-restaurants and best-dive-bars lists, a Daily Cardinal 'bite of the week'.

dish: The 'Bou Burger and a brandy old fashioned
w: A Madison institution since 1966 for PBRs, brandy old fashioneds and the extra-large 'Bou Burger — on Imbibe's where-to-drink, Madison Magazine's dive bars and City Cast's best dive bars.

dish: A gin Martini under the stuffed tiger
w: Strip-mall tiger-themed lounge, family-run since the mid-1960s with one of the city's oldest liquor licenses; Imbibe, Madison Magazine and City Cast all list it.

dish: Fish Fry Friday / Prime Rib Saturday with relish tray; Brian Bartels' old fashioneds
address: East Washington Ave (1885 building), Madison, WI
w: Bar author Brian Bartels' modern homage to the supper club in an 1885 building on East Wash; on Imbibe's where-to-drink list and City Cast's supper-club and fish-fry roundups.

dish: Burger with fried onions and homemade chili
w: West-side neighborhood tavern on Madison Magazine's dive-bar list and City Cast's 'bars that feel like home'.

dish: House-brewed Good Dog IPA or Black Earth Porter in the 1858 Fess Hotel
w: Madison's flagship brewpub since November 1994, in the NRHP-listed Fess Hotel (1858) at Doty & King; UpNorthNews readers' #1 Madison brewery 2025.
